faqs.a:
No license provided by this article shall be issued to or held by any:
(1)
Corporation, any of whose officers, directors, or stockholders holding ten percent
                  or more of the stock thereof, are not of good moral character;
(2)
Partnership, association, or limited liability company, and of whose officers, or
                  any of whose members holding ten percent or more interest therein, are not of good
                  character and reputation satisfactory to the licensing authority;
(3)
Person employing, assisted by, or financed in whole or in part by any person who is
                  not of good moral character and reputation satisfactory to the licensing authority;
(4)
Sheriff, deputy sheriff, police officer, or prosecuting officer or any of the licensing
                  authority's inspectors or employees; or
(5)
Person unless he is, with respect to his moral character, record, and reputation,
                  satisfactory to the licensing authority.
(Code 1981, § 16-17; Ord. No. 3292, § 1, 10-21-1996)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 12-48.5-108.
